title: 1.8 Family Actions
unit_outcome: Understand and say short German sentences about people and what they are doing.
goal: Say what family members are doing with spielt/spielen, lernt/lernen, arbeitet/arbeiten, kocht/kochen and redet/reden.
grammar_function: Person + singular verb; plural person + plural verb; arbeitet takes -et.
prerequisite: German 1.1-1.7: people, family, and one-or-two-people verbs.
speaking_outcome: Say what each family member is doing.
